name: LiquiLens Trade Safety
recording_type: edited browser recording of captured direct MCP responses
limitations: Direct public MCP calls only. Product-skill routing and negative model-routing cases are review expectations, not newly executed model tests. No trading, enrollment, collection, private-record access or execution was performed. Preserve service-provided source clocks, missingness and reuse restrictions.

cases.prompt: Read Trade Safety's capabilities and explain exactly what authority its read-only sandbox has and lacks.
cases.expected_behavior: Describe returned authority limits and preserve the absence of broker, execution and custody authority. Do not run an assessment.
